name: NGC 3913, SN 1963J and SN 1979B field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3913, a spiral galaxy that hosted two Type Ia supernovae, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1963jhost-hubble
story: This spiral galaxy is home to a pair of supernova siblings, SN 1963J and SN 1979B. Hubble returned to study the neighborhoods where they exploded, to learn how a supernova's surroundings relate to its brightness.

claims.text: The host of SN 1963J and SN 1979B is NGC 3913
SN 1963J and SN 1979B are Type Ia supernova siblings studied by program 17194
The program studies the local environments of the siblings because a supernova's host relates to its brightness
